properties.description: Allyl vinyl ether pre-reaction conformer; lowest verified minimum (global minimum of a 17-point torsional grid giving 12 distinct minima). B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP, gas phase, Opt+Freq, normal termination, 36 real modes (lowest 70.44 cm^-1). This is the barrier reference.
properties.conformational_note: The IRC-reached reactant conformer (ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0012/reactant_opt/reactant_opt.log, E = -270.326610062 Ha) lies +3.72 kcal/mol above this global minimum, so the barrier is 26.49 kcal/mol relative to the conformer actually connected to the saddle and 28.83 kcal/mol relative to the lowest verified minimum used here.

properties.description: Chair-like aromatic [3,3] saddle; normal termination, 35 real modes plus exactly one imaginary frequency -459.51 cm^-1 whose mode couples C3-O4 cleavage (projection 0.833) with C1-C6 formation (0.774). Geometry: r(C3-O4)=1.910 A, r(C1-C6)=2.342 A, C1-C2 1.382, C2-C3 1.404, O4-C5 1.282, C5-C6 1.383 A.
properties.note: Transition-state node: species-minimum evidence (0 imaginary frequencies) does not apply; the saddle evidence is bound through the step's ts_opt/frequency stages.

properties.description: Pent-4-enal product; lowest verified minimum (degenerate with p/grid/P_g7_180_0_180.log). Opt+Freq, normal termination, 36 real modes (lowest 79.87 cm^-1).
properties.conformational_note: The IRC-reached product conformer (ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0012/product_opt/product_opt.log, E = -270.355290267 Ha) lies +1.61 kcal/mol above this global minimum.

edges.direction_proof: Same saddle (-459.51 cm^-1) -> bidirectional IRC (irc=(calcfc,maxpoints=10,stepsize=5); sweep intentionally short, rx = +-1.487, both-direction convergence NOT achieved) -> the two native IRC outer frames re-optimized without constraints to zero-imaginary-frequency minima: reactant side (allyl vinyl ether, E = -270.326610062 Ha, 36 real modes) and product side (pent-4-enal, E = -270.355290267 Ha, 36 real modes). The connection therefore rests on the re-optimized outer frames and verified species identity, not on a converged IRC.
edges.barrier_reference: Barrier referenced to the lowest verified reactant minimum rc/grid/RC_g4_0_-120_0.log (-270.330334016 Ha); against the IRC-reached reactant conformer the barrier is 26.5 kcal/mol.
